chiSiamo.title: Who we are
chiSiamo.body:
Bitcoin USI Club is a group of students united by a passion for Bitcoin and economics. Our goal is to spread knowledge, promote critical thinking, and build a community of students and professional focused on a freer economic future.

Association recognised by Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) of Lugano.
